children.value: > Fact From Story: With the win, the Seahawks move to 3-1 on the season, including a perfect 2-0 record away from home.
> > Fact From Story: It was all Seahawks on “Monday Night Football” as the team turned in a dominant defensive effort en route to a 24-3 win over the Giants to wrap up Week 4 of the NFL season.
> > Fact From Story: The Seahawks advance to 3-1 on the year while the Giants fall to 1-3.

> > > > Fact From Story: In addition to sacking Daniel Jones 11 times, Seattle’s defense forced New York’s QB to commit three turnovers — a fumble and two interceptions, none more notable than rookie Devon Witherspoon's 97-yard pick-6 that turned the game on its ear.
> > > > Commonsense Knowledge: A dominant defensive effort contributes to winning a game.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Winning a game means the other team loses.
> Fact From Story: It was all Seahawks on “Monday Night Football” as the team turned in a dominant defensive effort en route to a 24-3 win over the Giants to wrap up Week 4 of the NFL season.

> > > Fact From Story: The Giants drop to 1-3 on the season.
> > > Fact From Story: The Seahawks advance to 3-1 on the year.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A win for one team means a loss for the other team.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A win on Monday Night Football counts as a regular season win.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Winning a game improves a team's record.
